The 960 Legacy Park Dr address on the board (kitting/QC) is a separate support address, not recorded.

Rule 6 base: 502 South Midway Road (governor release and UKG board agree; ECHO 2202 E 13th Ave is an inactive RCRA record, not used); building exists and is being refurbished; Welder WELDE005744 posted 2026-11-02 names Cordele GA 31015; pre-production.

Rehlko Workday board (read via its JSON API, 398 postings) has no welder or tank-welder posting at Kohler or anywhere live; the Kohler tank-welder ads exist only as expired aggregator copies (tealhq 410, tallo expired, monster/career.com/energyjobsearch blocked) and an ECHO search found no Rehlko facility in Kohler. No source places a fabrication/tank plant in Kohler; not recorded.

Quincy IL was a 24,000 sq ft leased weld-only shop (opened 2023; thefabricator Jan 2023); the May 2025 release still lists Quincy, but United Alloy's own site now lists only Janesville, Seguin and Union, and local reports (search snippet only, Muddy River News page blocked) say the plan was scrapped and the company leaves Quincy by March 2026. No street address found; no current site.

Tulsa 2121 N 161st E Ave is Wedlake Fabricating / Wedlake Enclosure Systems (IES Infrastructure), a custom generator-enclosure maker (IES 2020 release): lookalike base, 2 welder postings (carbon steel MIG/flux core). Mount Joy 1650 Steel Way is Greiner Industries (structural/plate/bridge steel): recorded as p-greiner-mount-joy-pa, new_excluded (no genset, tank-base, skid or BESS line). Neither is switchgear or an e-house.

Tomball's Paylocity board lists ~10 San Angelo TX postings (Production Manager, Maintenance Manager, Materials Manager, EHS, HR, Quality Engineer, Buyer, and a Project Manager for Industrial Site Remediation & Factory Launch of a brownfield property), but no welder posting, no street address (location is city only) and the retrofit has not been shown to have started. Fails rule 6; not recorded. Re-check when welder postings or an address appear.
